criteria.text: Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 9 June 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 9 December 2029 (36 months after Closing).
Calculates the long-stop date as 4 February 2027 (150 days after signing on 7 September 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 21 March 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (9 June 2028; 9 December 2029) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 14 September 2026 (634 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
Includes an 'Assumptions and open questions' section listing information that is missing or should be confirmed with the client.
